            t = i / (n - 12 - 1) if n - 12 > 1 else 0
            r = 0.3 + 0.2 * t  # Radial variation
            angle = 2 * np.pi * i * 1.618  # Golden angle for spiral
            additional[i] = [
                0.5 + r * np.cos(angle),
                0.5 + r * np.sin(angle),
                0.5  # Mid-level z-coordinate
            ]
        points2 = np.vstack([points2, additional])
    points2 = points2[:n]

    points3 = np.array([
        [0.5, 0.5, 1], [0.5, 0.5, 0],  # top and bottom faces
        [0.5, 1, 0.5], [0.5, 0, 0.5],  # front and back faces

        if remaining_count > 0:
            extra_points = np.random.rand(remaining_count, 3) * 0.6 + 0.2  # Centered in [0.2, 0.8]^3 for better spread
            additional_points.extend(extra_points.tolist())
        
        points3 = np.vstack([points3, additional_points[:n-7]])

            0.5 + r * np.sin(angle),

    points4 += np.random.normal(0, 0.01, (n, 3))  # Reduced noise for better stability
    points4 = np.clip(points4, 0, 1)

        x = np.sin(phi) * np.cos(theta)
        y = np.sin(phi) * np.sin(theta)
        z = np.cos(phi)
        points6[i] = [x, y, z]

    points6 += np.random.normal(0, 0.01, (n, 3))  # Reduced noise for better stability
    points6 = np.clip(points6, 0, 1)

                            return final_points
        except:
            continue
